description: Provenance for the vendored FedRAMP consolidated rules and their JSON Schema. The two files are byte-for-byte copies of upstream and must stay verbatim, so their provenance lives in this sidecar rather than in the files (#1115, #1172, #1354).
license_basis: No license declared upstream (GitHub reports license: none). Published by FedRAMP (GSA), a work of the United States Government, which is not subject to copyright in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105). Vendoring decided by the owner 2026-09-28.
re_vendor: Prefer the dated GitHub Release of FedRAMP/rules: download its fedramp-consolidated-rules-<version>.zip, check the zip's SHA-256 against the digest GitHub publishes for the asset, and confirm the two non-minified files in it are byte-identical to the same paths at the tag's commit. Replace both files verbatim (never the .min.json copies; the rules and the schema always move together), then update this sidecar (source_commit, upstream_version, release_tag, release_asset, retrieved, and each file's source_url, sha256 and bytes). Run bin/ksi_upstream_diff.rb first to see what changed, and preview with ksi:import[true] before importing.
